rules.last_activity: latest GitHub release date; for repos with no GitHub release, the last commit date on the default branch

status.active: last activity less than 365 days ago
status.inactive: last activity 730 or more days ago

rules.rank: within a category, entries with status active or slowing that are not add-ons (addon_of) are sorted by stars, highest first; rank 1 is the top pick. Categories with ranked=false (provider-specific SDKs) are not ranked.
rules.package_swift: min_ios, swift_tools and products are read from Package.swift at the latest release tag; if that tag is not a version number, at the highest version tag among the latest 100 tags; otherwise at the default branch. package_swift_at names the ref used.
rules.kind: library = can be added as an app dependency; tool = developer tool or build plugin, never an app library dependency
